name: Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access
short_description: Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access is Microsoft's cloud-delivered Security Service Edge (SSE) solution and the umbrella name for Microsoft Entra Private Access and Microsoft Entra Internet Access, securing access to private apps and internet resources based on identity and policy.
